object.attr: derived: CF-V45 (D-V29). `tag_issue` can issue a commit made by a git client or an unvalidated MCP commit. Answered on 2026-11-11 (Q-V9), to confirm: suspect and broken links don't block an issue; they are warned about (MELLON-VER-SRS-149, MELLON-VER-SRS-270). A broken link is a validation error (MELLON-CHECK-SRS-34, -35), so it is excepted here to follow Q-V9.
object.description: If the document at the commit for a new issue has a load error, or a validation error other than a broken link, Mellon shall refuse the issue and report the errors.
